name: mialmacen
description: An Electron application with React and TypeScript

scripts.smoke:ipc: npm run build && esbuild scripts/ipc-smoke.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=.ipcsmoke.cjs --external:electron --external:better-sqlite3 --tsconfig=tsconfig.node.json && electron --no-sandbox .ipcsmoke.cjs
